## Report something

Four routes, all of them welcome, and none of them needs to be polite
about it.

| If you found | Use |
| --- | --- |
| A result you cannot reproduce in jamovi | [Result does not reproduce](https://github.com/nicholaskarlson/data/issues/new?template=jamovi_output_mismatch.yml) |
| A wrong value, menu path, claim, or typo | [Report an erratum](https://github.com/nicholaskarlson/data/issues/new?template=errata_report.yml) |
| A question about a dataset or dictionary | [Ask about the data](https://github.com/nicholaskarlson/data/issues/new?template=data_question.yml) |
| An idea, or a question about using this material | [Discussions](https://github.com/nicholaskarlson/data/discussions) |

Questions about your *own* research data deserve a proper answer rather than a forum thread — write to the address on [NEKpress.ca](https://nekpress.ca). [COMMUNITY.md](COMMUNITY.md) says what goes where.

## What happens next

- Every report is acknowledged within **7 days**.
- A report that a **printed number is wrong** is recomputed against the verified result record for that study, and you get the recomputation — whether or not the book turns out to be wrong.
- Confirmed items appear on this page with a date, before any new edition ships.
- Reporters are credited by name unless they ask not to be.

Reporting that a result does not reproduce is not a complaint. It is the check this series asks readers to run, working as intended.

## Categories

| Category | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `numeric` | A printed value disagrees with the verified result record. |
| `procedure` | A jamovi menu path, option, or setting is wrong or has changed. |
| `interpretation` | Wording overstates, misstates, or misleads about what a result supports. |
| `data` | A dataset, dictionary, or checksum problem. |
| `typographic` | Spelling, notation, table, or layout. |
| `enhancement` | A reader suggestion. Not an error. |

## Recorded errata

None recorded yet.

That is a statement about what has been reported, not a claim that the books are perfect. If you find something, the templates above are the fastest way to have it fixed.
